canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Primary page background, top of surface stack

warm-cream.$description: Warm Cream — Card and elevated surface backgrounds, gentle warmth against pure white

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, icons, borders, and dark hero panels — the dominant structural color

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary text and softer borders where pure black would feel too heavy

deep-panel.$description: Deep Panel — Dark feature cards, inverse surface for hero blocks, and high-contrast panels

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Muted helper text, disabled button fills, and tertiary borders

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Hairline dividers, nav separators, subtle structural borders

lilac-mist.$description: Lilac Mist — Cool-toned decorative borders, illustration fills, and subtle chrome highlights

bubblegum.$description: Bubblegum — Primary brand accent — pill-shaped CTAs, announcement bar background, active highlights; vivid pink against white is the visual signature

cotton-pink.$description: Cotton Pink — Softer pink surface for secondary buttons and pastel card variants

blush-mist.$description: Blush Mist — Lightest pink wash for category tile backgrounds and quiet brand surfaces

ice-blue.$description: Ice Blue — Cool supporting accent for product UI screenshots, informational tiles, and category surface variation

voltage-lime.$description: Voltage Lime — High-energy accent for spotlight highlights, image overlays, and surprise moments — used sparingly for visual punctuation

soehne.$description: Single typeface across all UI. Body and UI copy at 400–500, navigation and labels at 500–600, subheads at 700, and display headlines at 900 — the extreme weight contrast between 400 body and 900 display is the signature typographic move. Aggressive negative tracking (-0.025em at display sizes) tightens headlines into bold block-like forms that feel architectural rather than airy.
